---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible behavior or documentation defect
---

## Actual problem

Describe the affected file or behavior and the impact. Indicate whether this concerns draft documentation or an implemented feature.

## Reproduction and environment

Provide minimal steps, revision, tool/browser/OS versions, input method, and physical-device versus emulation details where relevant.

## Expected and observed behavior

Explain the evidence and cite the relevant requirement. Do not include credentials, private customer content, or personal information in logs or screenshots.
